title: The Future
author: Dangerous_Three_8506
selftext:
I wish the big companies like Nintendo had a plan for AI. A plan where they built a "Public library".

A world where anyone can make a Zelda Game, submit it to Nintendo Publishing, it's put in their library like Steam. Then everyone can make Zelda, Mario and Pokemon games. Nintendo can just pull the game off their shelf if it goes against their franchise.

Nintendo can take X% royalties. There would be so many games. Nintendo could have a giant asset library with approved 3D models for free. I hope some company does something like this, then we can finally have those sweet sweet games we have been waiting for.

Real time Pokémon battles, multi-verse Zelda stories, etc.

It's becoming so easy to make a game and its always nice to make a game you love. I love Pokémon!

I wish it was a High Risk Library. Where if the game didn't fit the franchise it's pulled. I hate the baby soccer mom, everyone gets a trophy attitude. Just pull the game, it's not Zelda lore. boo hoo, your game isn't good and we thought it was at the start.
